description:
A historian of science needs their library organized by era. Your Zotero library contains 18 papers spanning from 1905 to 2020.

Your task is to:
1. Create three new collections with these EXACT names:
   - "Pre-1950 Foundations"
   - "1950-1999 Classical"
   - "2000s and Beyond"

2. Sort every paper in your library into the correct collection based on its publication year (visible in the Date/Year column):
   - Papers published BEFORE 1950 go into "Pre-1950 Foundations"
   - Papers published from 1950 to 1999 (inclusive) go into "1950-1999 Classical"
   - Papers published in 2000 or later go into "2000s and Beyond"

3. Ensure every paper is assigned to exactly one of these collections.

To see the year, look at the 'Date' or 'Year' column in the main pane. You can drag and drop items into collections.

pre_1950: On the Electrodynamics of Moving Bodies
On Computable Numbers, with an Application to the Entscheidungsproblem
An Unsolvable Problem of Elementary Number Theory
classical: A Method for the Construction of Minimum-Redundancy Codes
Molecular Structure of Nucleic Acids: A Structure for Deoxyribose Nucleic Acid
A Note on Two Problems in Connexion with Graphs
Recursive Functions of Symbolic Expressions and Their Computation by Machine, Part I
modern: ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
Mastering the Game of Go with Deep Neural Networks and Tree Search
BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
